title: State builds commit one row at a time. Observation:
notes: rebuilding the disposable state of the real archive (57,181 conversations) took
about 2h40 on a USB exFAT disk (about 28 ms per commit), and the full
review): fragments commit once per segment (`ConversationArchiveState.ts:129`),
but materialized records (`:198`) and pending deliveries (`:304`) autocommit
per row, about 114k commits per build; no journal or synchronous pragma is set;
the drill prints nothing until its final JSON (`runRecoveryDrillStep.ts:12`).
